scope: Additive TH18 scope correction for the historical standalone Eagle Artillery.
game_version: Town Hall 17 update; applicable to TH18 because the merged Town Hall weapon persists.

sources.title: THE TOWN HALL 17 UPDATE IS HERE!
sources.limitations: Confirms that the Town Hall and Eagle Artillery merge into Inferno Artillery. It does not supply a complete TH18 Town Hall weapon lifecycle, projectile collision or tick-order specification.

known_uncertainties: Standalone Eagle Artillery data and its historical Core path are retained for compatibility but do not establish a deployable permanent TH18 entity.
The TH18 Town Hall weapon must be assessed as its own active defensive-building increment; no Eagle proxy is authorized.
conclusion: Standalone Eagle Artillery is excluded from active TH18 permanent-content integration because the official TH17 merge removes it as an independent building; its historical data is preserved without a false TH18 completion claim.
